name: ref-persistence
displayName: REF - Persistence mechanism created or changed
description: Scheduled task created, deleted, enabled or updated (4698/4699/4700/4702), or a service installed or its start type changed (System 7045/7040). Windows updating its own tasks under \Microsoft\ as SYSTEM or NETWORK SERVICE is excluded from 4702 only; task creation and deletion are never excluded.

criteria.query:
union isfuzzy=true (SecurityEvent | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventID in (4698, 4699, 4700, 4701, 4702) | extend Task = extract('<Data Name="TaskName">([^<]*)', 1, EventData), ActorSid = iff(isnotempty(SubjectUserSid), SubjectUserSid, extract('<Data Name="SubjectUserSid">([^<]*)', 1, EventData)) | where not(ActorSid in ("S-1-5-18","S-1-5-19","S-1-5-20") and Task startswith @"\Microsoft\") | where not(Task matches regex @"^\\SoftLanding\\S-1-[0-9-]+\\SoftLanding(Deferral|Trigger)Task-") | where not(EventID == 4702 and ActorSid == "S-1-5-18" and (Task startswith @"\REF-" or Task startswith @"\MicrosoftEdgeUpdateTask")) | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity, Actor=SubjectUserName, Detail=Task), (Event | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventLog == "System" and EventID == 7045 | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity=substring(RenderedDescription,0,400), Actor=UserName, Detail=Source), (Event | where ingestion_time() > ago(5m) | where EventLog == "System" and EventID == 7040 | where not(UserName in~ ("NT AUTHORITY/SYSTEM","NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM","NT AUTHORITY/NETWORK SERVICE","NT AUTHORITY\\NETWORK SERVICE") and RenderedDescription has_any ("Background Intelligent Transfer Service","Microsoft Account Sign-in Assistant","Delivery Optimization","IsolationSession","Windows Modules Installer","Defender Update Service")) | project TimeGenerated, Computer, EventID, Activity=substring(RenderedDescription,0,400), Actor=UserName, Detail=Source) | extend LocalTime = format_datetime(datetime_utc_to_local(TimeGenerated,"America/Los_Angeles"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss") | project LocalTime, Computer, EventID, Activity, Actor, Detail
| where not(EventID == 7040 and (Activity has_any ("start type of the Claude service", "start type of the ChatGPT service") or (Actor == "S-1-5-18" and Activity has "Microsoft Account Sign-in Assistant"))) | where not(EventID == 7045 and Activity has @"system32\drivers\wd\")   // RA-027 12 Oct
